title: An unknown status value is refused
preconditions: A fresh live RFQ where QA vendor 1 submitted a bid ({{bidUuid}}); caller is the buyer.
steps: 3. Assert 422 code 2 and the bid unchanged.
expectedResult: HTTP 422, code 2 'Insufficient parameters'; the bid is unchanged.
rationale: Only active, rejected, revoke and in_active may be set from outside; 'selected' would be an award by the back door. app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb update_bid_status.

title: A status call without a status is refused
preconditions: A fresh live RFQ where QA vendor 1 submitted a bid ({{bidUuid}}); caller is the buyer.
rationale: A call that says nothing must not be read as some default status. app/controllers/api/bids_controller.rb update_bid_status.
